offering_description.value: Operates a portfolio of digital media brands and online properties covering technology, shopping, gaming, health, and martech, plus subscription and cybersecurity/connectivity services. Sells advertising and lead generation to businesses and subscriptions to consumers and businesses.

primary_products.value: digital media websites; VPN and cybersecurity software; email marketing software; online games and content; internet speed testing tools

primary_services.value: digital advertising; lead generation; performance marketing; email and marketing technology services; connectivity services

customer_segment.value: B2B: advertisers, brands, marketers, and businesses buying marketing tech and lead generation; B2C: online readers, shoppers, gamers, and subscribers of VPN, email and other tools

end_markets.value: digital advertising; technology; consumer health and wellness; e-commerce; gaming; cybersecurity

revenue_model.value: advertising: display, native and sponsored advertising on owned websites; commissions or management fees: affiliate and performance marketing commissions from shopping and referral traffic; subscription: VPN, cybersecurity, email marketing and connectivity subscriptions; service fees: lead generation and marketing services for business clients
revenue_model.category: advertising; commissions or management fees; subscription; service fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: publishes online content and sells advertising and leads to brands and marketers; software / platform: offers subscription software for security, email marketing and connectivity to consumers and businesses

geography_served.value: global: Primarily US audiences with significant international audience and customers

specialization.value: related lines: digital media, performance marketing, cybersecurity and martech, and connectivity software, sharing online audiences

distribution_channels.value: online: owned websites, apps and online subscription sales; direct sales: advertising sales teams selling to brands and agencies

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy rules (GDPR, CCPA), FTC advertising and affiliate disclosure rules, and email marketing regulations
